mechanism: Amphetamine's sympathomimetic effects (increased heart rate, blood pressure, contractility) directly antagonize amlodipine's calcium channel blocking and vasodilatory effects, potentially reducing antihypertensive efficacy and increasing cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative stimulant or adjust amlodipine dosing; counsel patient on cardiovascular warning signs and avoid high amphetamine doses.
